Plan the implementation of a JSX-only supplement-brand landing page prototype with 4-5 distinct hero/landing variants of the SAME page. The user wants the global ecom agent team involved.

## Locked decisions
- **Stack:** Vite + React 19 + TypeScript strict + Tailwind 4 + shadcn/ui (no Next.js, no Hydrogen)
- **Scope:** 4-5 distinct hero/landing variants for ONE fictional supplement brand. Each variant is a complete landing page (hero + below-fold sections), routed at `/variant-1`, `/variant-2`, etc., with an index page at `/` listing all variants for side-by-side comparison.
- **Brand:** Fictional supplement brand to be invented by the agent team (decoder picks niche → token sets palette → spark/merch write voice).
- **Working dir:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/` (currently EMPTY — no git, no node_modules, no package.json).
- **No Shopify integration.** Pure design prototype. No real cart, no real checkout, no Storefront API. Mock product data only.

## Available global agent team (from ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md)
**ECOM CROSS-FUNCTIONAL UNIT** — orchestrated by `catalyst` (CRO Lead):
- `decoder` — top-50 DTC brand teardowns (supplements queue: Ritual, AG1, Hims, Care/of, Magic Spoon, Liquid IV)
- `elio` — ecom UI/motion specialist (PDP, hero, trust, post-purchase, mobile)
- `token` — Tailwind 4 design tokens (palette, spacing, radius, motion)
- `spark` — above-fold hero/CTA copy ONLY (40%+ lift mandate)
- `merch` — below-fold body/objection/FAQ/trust copy
- `ecom-cro` — below-fold mechanics (variants, bundles, cart drawer, checkout flow, upsell)
- `figma-synth` — JSX → .fig + Code Connect (optional for this build)
- `quill` — brand voice ratification only
Plus: `riko` (scaffolding), `koda` (component build), `vega` (design lead approval), `sage` (review), `luna` (tests — light for prototype), `mira` (post-build lessons).

## Available ecom KB
- `~/.claude/memory/design/ecom/hero-homepage-patterns.md` — 4 hero archetypes documented (lifestyle-static, video-override, split-hero, spec-hero)
- `~/.claude/memory/content/ecom/objection-handling-library.md` — supplements top-5 objections LIVE
- `~/.claude/memory/content/ecom/pdp-copy-patterns.md` — benefits-first PDP
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ecom-funnel-cro-playbook.md` — CRO surface priority
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ecom-brand-teardowns.md` — supplements bank queued (decoder must populate)
**KB GAP:** trust-social-proof-patterns.md NOT YET WRITTEN. Mobile-ecom-patterns.md NOT YET WRITTEN.

## What I need from you (the Plan agent)
Design the optimal **agent dispatch sequence** + **technical implementation** to deliver:

1. Working Vite + React 19 + TS + Tailwind 4 + shadcn project scaffold
2. Fictional supplement brand identity (name + niche + palette + voice + product)
3. 4-5 distinct landing-page variants — each a different above-fold/conversion strategy (e.g., spec-hero, lifestyle, split-hero, video-style, scientific-credibility) with full below-fold (benefits, ingredients, trust stack, reviews, FAQ, CTA)
4. Mock product data, mock testimonials, mock review counts (don't hardcode "100,000 customers" — use believable seed numbers)
5. Index page at `/` showing all variants side-by-side
6. Mobile-first, fully responsive, dark-mode optional
7. Real CRO mechanics in JSX: sticky add-to-cart on mobile, subscribe-vs-onetime toggle, bundle pricing, ingredient transparency module, review distribution stars, FAQ accordion, exit-intent placeholder
8. Production-grade JSX (no `any`, strict TS, accessible components)

## Deliverable: a step-by-step plan covering
- **Phase order:** which agents run, in what sequence, what they deliver, what blocks what
- **Project structure:** folder layout (`/src/variants/`, `/src/components/shared/`, `/src/data/mock.ts`, `/src/lib/tokens.ts`)
- **Variant differentiation strategy:** what makes variants 1-5 actually different (not just color swaps — different conversion psychology each)
- **Routing:** React Router or simple page-switcher? Recommend.
- **Token strategy:** how token agent's output flows into Tailwind 4 config
- **Mock data shape:** TypeScript interfaces for Product, Review, Ingredient, Bundle
- **CRO mechanics list:** the actual interactive components needed (sticky bar, drawer, accordion, toggle)
- **Quality gates:** what sage reviews, what luna tests (lightly — it's a prototype)
- **Risk callouts:** any agent dependency loops, missing KB blockers, or scope creep risks

Reference filenames + agent names directly. Be specific. 600 words max.

## Implementation Plan: Supplement Brand Landing Variants

### Phase Order (Agent Dispatch Sequence)

**Phase 0 — KB Gap Fill (parallel, blocks Phase 2)**
- `decoder` runs supplements teardown queue (Ritual, AG1, Hims, Care/of, Magic Spoon, Liquid IV) and writes to `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ecom-brand-teardowns.md`. Output: 5 above-fold patterns + below-fold rhythms + objection ladders. **Blocks variant differentiation.**
- `decoder` also drafts `trust-social-proof-patterns.md` (gap) — needed for variant 3/4 trust stacks.

**Phase 1 — Scaffold (sequential, no blockers)**
- `riko` scaffolds Vite + React 19 + TS strict + Tailwind 4 + shadcn at the empty cwd. Installs `react-router-dom@7`, `lucide-react`, `class-variance-authority`, `tailwind-merge`. Configures `tsconfig.json` with `"strict": true, "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true`. Adds shadcn primitives: button, accordion, sheet (cart drawer), tabs, badge, separator, dialog (exit-intent).

**Phase 2 — Brand + Tokens (parallel after Phase 0)**
- `decoder` picks niche (recommend: cognitive/nootropic OR women's hormonal — underserved vs AG1's general-wellness saturation) and invents brand name + product.
- `token` derives palette from chosen niche → emits `src/lib/tokens.ts` + Tailwind 4 `@theme` block in `src/index.css` (CSS-first config, no `tailwind.config.js`). Tokens: `--color-brand-*`, `--radius-*`, `--ease-*`, `--shadow-*`.
- `quill` ratifies voice (1-page brand bible).

**Phase 3 — Copy (parallel, depends on Phase 2)**
- `spark` writes 5 distinct above-fold hooks (one per variant) targeting 40%+ lift archetypes.
- `merch` writes shared below-fold: benefits, ingredient stories, FAQ (using objection-handling-library.md top-5), review quotes.
- `ecom-cro` specs interactive mechanics inventory.

**Phase 4 — Build (sequential, the long phase)**
- `elio` + `koda` build shared components first, then 5 variants.
- `catalyst` orchestrates variant differentiation reviews.

**Phase 5 — QA**
- `sage` reviews TS strictness, a11y (axe pass), responsive breakpoints, token discipline (no hardcoded hex).
- `luna` writes light smoke tests: each route renders, sticky-bar appears <768px, accordion toggles, subscribe toggle updates price.
- `vega` final design approval.
- `mira` captures lessons.

### Project Structure
```
src/
  variants/
    Variant1Spec.tsx        // spec-hero (data-dense, "the science")
    Variant2Lifestyle.tsx   // lifestyle-static (aspirational photo, soft CTA)
    Variant3Split.tsx       // split-hero (ingredient transparency left, hero right)
    Variant4Video.tsx       // video-override style (autoplay loop placeholder, founder-voice)
    Variant5Clinical.tsx    // scientific-credibility (citations, doctor endorsements)
  components/shared/
    ProductCard.tsx, BundleSelector.tsx, SubscribeToggle.tsx,
    StickyAddToCart.tsx, CartDrawer.tsx, IngredientModule.tsx,
    ReviewDistribution.tsx, FAQAccordion.tsx, TrustBar.tsx,
    ExitIntent.tsx, Nav.tsx, Footer.tsx
  pages/
    Index.tsx               // `/` — 5 variant thumbnails, iframe previews + jump links
  data/
    mock.ts                 // Product, Reviews, Ingredients, Bundles, Testimonials
  lib/
    tokens.ts, cn.ts, types.ts
  App.tsx                   // Router
```

### Variant Differentiation (psychology, not color)
1. **Spec-hero** — "5 actives, 0 fillers" data table above fold, rational buyer.
2. **Lifestyle** — full-bleed model shot, single sentence promise, emotional buyer.
3. **Split-hero** — left: ingredient close-up + dosage; right: product. Transparency-driven skeptic.
4. **Video/founder** — looping b-roll, founder quote overlay, narrative buyer.
5. **Clinical** — citation badges, NSF/3rd-party-tested, MD endorsement quote, authority buyer.

### Routing
**React Router 7** (`createBrowserRouter`). Simpler than page-switcher, gives real URLs for stakeholder shareback. Routes: `/`, `/variant-1` … `/variant-5`. Index uses scaled iframes for true side-by-side.

### Token Strategy
Tailwind 4 CSS-first via `@theme` in `index.css`. `token` agent outputs design tokens as CSS custom properties; `tokens.ts` re-exports as TS constants for inline-style edge cases. No `tailwind.config.js`.

### Mock Data Shape
`Product { id, name, slug, priceOnetime, priceSubscribe, servings, actives: Ingredient[] }`, `Ingredient { name, dosageMg, claim, citation? }`, `Review { rating, title, body, author, verified, date }`, `Bundle { id, products, discountPct }`, `Testimonial { quote, author, role, avatar }`. Seed: 847 reviews, 4.7 avg, distribution skewed realistically.

### CRO Mechanics
StickyAddToCart (mobile <768px), CartDrawer (Sheet), SubscribeToggle (saves 15%), BundleSelector (1/2/3-pack), FAQAccordion, IngredientModule (expand for citation), ReviewDistribution (5-star bar chart), ExitIntent (Dialog on mouseleave, desktop only).

### Quality Gates
`sage`: strict TS pass, a11y (focus traps in Sheet/Dialog, ARIA on accordion), no `any`, no inline hex. `luna`: 5 route render tests, sticky-bar viewport test, subscribe-toggle price math, accordion toggle. Skip E2E.

### Risk Callouts
- **Decoder backlog blocks Phase 2** — run Phase 0 first, do not parallelize with Phase 1 build temptation.
- **Tailwind 4 + shadcn compatibility** — shadcn CLI now supports v4; verify `riko` uses the v4-compatible registry, not v3 templates.
- **Variant sameness drift** — `catalyst` must enforce "different conversion psychology" rubric at Phase 4 mid-review or variants collapse into color swaps.
- **Trust KB gap** — if `decoder` skips `trust-social-proof-patterns.md`, variant 5 (clinical) ships weak.
- **Scope creep** — no real cart persistence, no checkout flow past drawer, no auth. State lives in `useState` + `useReducer`, no Zustand.

### Critical Files for Implementation
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/src/App.tsx
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/src/index.css
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/src/data/mock.ts
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/src/lib/tokens.ts
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/src/components/shared/StickyAddToCart.tsx
